authority: Aligned with ISLRTC (Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre) vocabulary standards
disclaimer: Indian Sign Language (ISL) uses two-handed alphabets and specialized regional syntactic markers. EduVaani currently supports this curated vocabulary subset. It does not provide full conversational sign-to-speech translation.

Namaste.label: Namaste
Namaste.handShape: Both palms open flat, pressed together with fingers pointing upright at center of chest
Namaste.motion: Static prayer posture with a gentle respectful head bow

Hello.label: Hello
Hello.handShape: Dominant hand open flat with fingers together near right temple or brow
Hello.motion: Waving smoothly outward away from temple in an arc

Thank You.label: Thank You
Thank You.handShape: Flat open hand with fingertips touching chin or lower lip
Thank You.motion: Moving gently downward and forward toward the conversation partner

Yes.label: Yes
Yes.handShape: Closed fist (S-hand shape) held at chest level
Yes.motion: Repeated vertical nodding motion from the wrist imitating a head nod

No.label: No
No.handShape: Index and middle fingers extended apart, thumb extended below
No.motion: Index and middle fingers snap down onto the thumb tip twice like a beak

Good.label: Good
Good.handShape: Closed fist with thumb extended upright (thumbs up)
Good.motion: Brought forward firmly from chest level

Bad.label: Bad
Bad.handShape: Fist with thumb pointed downward (thumbs down) or flat palm swept downward
Bad.motion: Sharp downward motion away from chest

Help.label: Help
Help.handShape: Closed fist with thumb up resting on top of flat horizontal base palm
Help.motion: Both hands lifted together upward and slightly forward

Please.label: Please
Please.handShape: Open flat palm facing inward touching chest
Please.motion: Clockwise circular soothing rubbing motion over the heart area

English.label: English
English.handShape: Dominant hand clasps across the back and palm of non-dominant hand
English.motion: Two gentle handshake or clasping pulses at upper chest

Learn.label: Learn
Learn.handShape: Non-dominant flat palm acts as open book; dominant hand scoops from it
Learn.motion: Dominant fingertips touch palm, gather upward into fingertips touching forehead

India.label: India
India.handShape: Thumb of dominant hand with other fingers curled into gentle fist
India.motion: Thumb touches center of forehead gently (bindi mark position)

Friend.label: Friend
Friend.handShape: Both index fingers hooked like links in a chain
Friend.motion: Right index hooks over left index, then rotated and reversed

Water.label: Water
Water.handShape: W-shape formed by index, middle, ring fingers extended or cupped hand
Water.motion: Index finger taps the center of the lower lip twice

Teacher.label: Teacher
Teacher.motion: Hands move forward from temples opening slightly into flat palms

A.label: A
A.handShape: Left hand open flat pointing up; right index finger touches the tip of left thumb

B.label: B
B.handShape: Both hands form circles with thumbs and index fingers touching together
B.motion: Circles placed side by side forming the twin lobes of letter B

C.label: C
C.handShape: Hand curved into a clear semi-circular C shape
C.motion: Static hold with open palm facing sideways

D.label: D
D.handShape: Left hand index finger extended upright; right hand C-shape touches left index
D.motion: Right C touches left vertical index to form letter D shape

E.label: E
E.handShape: Left hand open flat with fingers spread; right index finger touches the tip of left index finger
E.motion: Static touch on first finger (vowel sequence A-E-I-O-U)

I.label: I
I.handShape: Left hand open flat; right index finger touches the tip of left middle finger
I.motion: Static touch on middle finger (third vowel)

L.label: L
L.handShape: Index finger extended vertically, thumb extended horizontally at 90 degrees
L.motion: Static clear L shape in front of chest

O.label: O
O.handShape: Left hand open flat; right index finger touches the tip of left ring finger
O.motion: Static touch on fourth finger (fourth vowel)

V.label: V
V.handShape: Index and middle fingers extended apart in a V, thumb holding ring and pinky
